prompt:
Build a three-phase shunt STATCOM for a 400 V line-to-line, 50 Hz system. A three-phase grid and load must share a common PCC, and a controllable three-phase voltage-source converter with DC-link energy storage must connect in shunt at that PCC through one coupling reactor per phase. Read Vsrc_LL and P_load from base-workspace variables; their nominal values are 400 V and 10000 W, and each operates over a +/-10% envelope. The converter must keep its measured DC-link voltage near 700 V as the grid voltage and load vary, while exchanging predominantly reactive compensation current with the PCC. The DC-link regulation and reactive compensation must establish promptly after startup. Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries Vdc, Vac, Igrid and Icomp. Vdc must be the physical DC-link voltage; Vac must be one physical PCC phase voltage; Igrid and Icomp must be the corresponding physical grid and converter-branch currents.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XELEC06.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
